Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Interface API

  • public interface API
    Marker interface for APIs that can be visited by KDC agents.

    Implementations define the operations that an Agent may invoke on a receiving endpoint. The receiver may reside on either the client or server side of a connection.

    KDC supports both synchronous and asynchronous agent communication.

    This interface declares no methods. Implementations provide the application-specific operations available to agents.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
